thread:
Ethan R.: hey team — first day! quick map request: where do i post (1) laptop/VPN issues, (2) API/SDK questions, (3) product/roadmap asks, and (4) a short intro? also how do i quiet the bots during off hours?

IT Support: welcome Ethan! :wave: short answers: (1) tag @IT Support in #help-it (or DM for sensitive info), (2) #eng or #devx for docs/help, (3) #product, and (4) #introductions or #random for intros. For hardware include OS + short error/screenshot.

IT Support: example error paste (minimal, in a code block):

IT Support: ```
OS: macOS 13.6
Tool: rwctl 0.9.2
Cmd: rwctl login --org redwood
Err: unauthorized (401)
Steps: cleared token, reinstalled
```

Ethan R.: nice, thanks. about bots — onboarding/standup keep pinging me early (i'm UTC+0). can i pause them?

Ops Bot: automated: Standup reminders and onboarding tips are adjustable. DM me `standup prefs` to set your reminder time. For onboarding DM @Onboarding Bot `pause` or run `/onboard snooze 7d` in any channel.

Maya L.: etiquette tips: 1) Threads > new messages for follow-ups so answers stay with the question. 2) Add a 1-line subject in the root msg for longer threads (e.g., "SDK auth 401"). 3) React with :white_check_mark: or :eyes: once resolved so threads don't linger.

Zoe H.: timezone courtesy: prefix async asks with "no-urgent" if you don't need an immediate reply, e.g., "no-urgent: can someone point me to the embeddings quickstart?" People check mornings, so that helps. Also add timezone to your Slack profile.

Ethan R.: cool — what about @channel/@here rules? when is that ok?

Maya L.: @channel/@here only for org-wide urgent announcements or scheduled maintenance. For team pings use team channels and prefer @team if configured. If something can wait, schedule the message or leave it in #new-hires and tag it "help-needed".

Ethan R.: perfect. last one: where do we post pairing requests or 1:1 scheduling?

Zoe H.: DMs for 1:1s. For pairing that might help others, post in the team channel with availability and timezone; prefix with "pairing:" to make it scannable.

Ethan R.: thanks everyone  this is super helpful. i'll mute onboarding until day 2 and update my timezone. :thumbsup:
